items.source: ancestorTagClass - the ancestor Class being searched for
items.translation: ancestorTagClass - 正在搜索的祖先 Class

items.source: tag - the tag whose ancestors are to be checked
items.translation: tag - 要检查其祖先的标签

items.source: If the String does not match 'request', 'session', 'page' or 'application', the method will return PageContext.PAGE_SCOPE.
items.translation: 如果 `String` 不匹配 'request'、'session'、'page' 或 'application'，该方法将返回 `PageContext.PAGE_SCOPE`。

items.source: Determine whether the supplied Tag has any ancestor tag of the supplied type, throwing an IllegalStateException if not.
items.translation: 确定提供的 `Tag` 是否包含任何指定类型的祖先标签，如果没有则抛出 IllegalStateException。

items.source: Determine whether the supplied Tag has any ancestor tag of the supplied type.
items.translation: 确定提供的 `Tag` 是否有任何类型为所提供的祖先标签。

items.source: Constant identifying the application scope.
items.translation: 标识应用程序范围的常量。

items.source: Constant identifying the page scope.
items.translation: 标识页面范围的常量。

items.source: Constant identifying the request scope.
items.translation: 标识请求范围的常量。

items.source: Constant identifying the session scope.
items.translation: 标识会话范围的常量。

items.source: IllegalArgumentException - if any of the supplied arguments is null, or in the case of the String-typed arguments, is composed wholly of whitespace; or if the supplied ancestorTagClass is not type-assignable to the Tag class
items.translation: IllegalArgumentException - 如果提供的任何参数为 null，或者在 String 类型的参数的情况下，该参数完全由空白字符组成；或者如果提供的 ancestorTagClass 无法赋值给 Tag 类类型。

items.source: IllegalArgumentException - if either of the supplied arguments is null; or if the supplied ancestorTagClass is not type-assignable to the Tag class
items.translation: IllegalArgumentException - 如果提供的任一参数为 null； 或者如果提供的 ancestorTagClass 无法赋值给 Tag 类类型。

items.source: IllegalArgumentException - if the supplied scope is null
items.translation: IllegalArgumentException - 如果提供的 scope 为 null

items.source: IllegalStateException - if the supplied tag does not have a tag of the supplied parentTagClass as an ancestor
items.translation: IllegalStateException - 如果提供的 tag 没有以提供的 parentTagClass 为祖先的标签

items.source: tagName - the name of the tag; for example 'option'
items.translation: tagName - tag 的名称；例如 'option'

items.source: ancestorTagName - the name of the ancestor tag; for example 'select'
items.translation: ancestorTagName - 祖先标签的名称；例如 'select'

items.source: page will be transformed to PageContext.PAGE_SCOPE
items.translation: page 将转换为 PageContext.PAGE_SCOPE

items.source: request will be transformed to PageContext.REQUEST_SCOPE
items.translation: request 将转换为 PageContext.REQUEST_SCOPE

items.source: session will be transformed to PageContext.SESSION_SCOPE
items.translation: session 将转换为 PageContext.SESSION_SCOPE

items.source: application will be transformed to PageContext.APPLICATION_SCOPE
items.translation: application 将转换为 PageContext.APPLICATION_SCOPE

items.source: scope - the String to inspect
items.translation: scope - 要检查的 String

items.source: true if the supplied Tag has any ancestor tag of the supplied type
items.translation: true 如果提供的 Tag 具有任何指定类型的祖先标签。

items.source: the scope found, or PageContext.PAGE_SCOPE if no scope matched
items.translation: 找到的作用域，或者如果没有匹配的作用域则为PageContext.PAGE_SCOPE

items.source: Alef Arendsen, Rob Harrop, Juergen Hoeller, Rick Evans
items.translation: Alef Arendsen, Rob Harrop, Juergen Hoeller, Rick Evans

items.source: Determines the scope for a given input String.
items.translation: 确定给定输入 String 的作用域。

items.source: Field Details
items.translation: 字段详情
